title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover + load-shedding (urgent)
author: Noah Kim
description: This hotfix addresses three reliability regressions surfaced during the incident on 2026-02-14: 1) SLO enforcer transient mis-evaluation causing aggressive circuit-breaker tripping in regional clusters, 2) incorrect load-shedding ordering that allowed high-priority requests to be dropped, and 3) a failover race that left requests stalled when regions shifted. Motivation: production latency and error-rate SLOs were breached for ~30 minutes under a regional capacity event. The patch tightens enforcer hysteresis, fixes ordering in the shedding queue, and adds an explicit handoff path to avoid the failover race. Summary of changes and validation checklist: - Update enforcer hysteresis/decay logic to require N consistent breaches within window before tripping (defaults preserved for non-critical tenants). - Add per-priority FIFO ordering guarantees to the load-shedding queue and ensure high-priority routes are evaluated pre-shed. - Add an explicit in-flight handoff/ack path during regional failover to prevent double-shed/stall races. - Add metrics and traces: slo_enforcer.trip_count, slo_enforcer.hysteresis_events, shedding.queue_drops_by_priority. - Add unit and integration tests that simulate staged regional capacity loss and ensure failover completes without stalled requests. - Manual canary run performed in us-west-2 on 2026-02-19 with traffic replay; SLO violations reduced to baseline. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] E2E replay validation - [x] Observability dashboards updated - [x] Release notes included Related: ENG-3141 (primary), SUP-1289 (customer-reported), ENG-3142 (follow-up doc). See commit history and review conversation for implementation details and rationale. This description is a single continuous string and includes the checklist and validation summary.
commits: fix(slo-enforcer): require consecutive breaches before trip (hysteresis)
fix(shedding): preserve per-priority FIFO ordering and early eval for high-priority routes
fix(failover): add in-flight handoff acknowledgement to regional failover path
test(slo-enforcer): add unit tests for hysteresis and trip-flapping
test(e2e): replay scenario for regional capacity event (us-west-2)
review_comments: Lena Ortiz: Looks good overall; please add a short comment explaining the magic number in hysteresis window (5s) - prefer constant with name.
Noah Kim: Added named constant HYSTERESIS_WINDOW_MS and updated comment to reference ENG-3141 rationale.
Samir Patel: I saw one flaky in the e2e when replaying 2x traffic. Recommend adding an extra backoff in the handoff ack loop to avoid tight retry bursts.
Noah Kim: Added exponential backoff (50ms->400ms) with jitter; reran canary and confirmed stability.
Maya Chen: Approved after backoff addition. Observability metrics look sane and are queryable on the dashboard; consider adding an alert for hysteresis_event_rate spike.
Noah Kim: Added alert rule with 5m eval; will follow up in ENG-3142 for tuned thresholds.
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (flaky fixed after retry logic)
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer to avoid spurious circuit-breaker trips during short spikes; fix load-shedding ordering to preserve high-priority requests; eliminate regional failover race that could stall in-flight requests. Deploy to all regions; no user-visible breaking changes.
